content.short: Snuggle offers automated liquidity management for Bitcoin, ETH and stablecoin deposits.
content.description: Snuggle is an automated concentrated liquidity manager that rebalances Uniswap V3-style positions to maximise fee income while limiting impermanent loss. It covers more than 58 pools across five DEXs including Uniswap V3, Aerodrome, PancakeSwap, SushiSwap V3 and Camelot V3, and is deployed on Robinhood Chain, Base and Arbitrum. Depositors supply Bitcoin, ETH or stablecoins and can withdraw at any time, with rebalancing performed without swapping out of the position. The interface also handles swaps and tax reporting.
content.meta: Automated liquidity management for Bitcoin, ETH and stablecoin holders on Robinhood Chain.
